active.policy: Built, tested, budgeted, and eligible for the governed release artifact.

compat.policy: Preserve wire, symbol, JSON, hash, and operator compatibility without granting production authority.
invariants: compatibility handlers are never proof of production ingress
legacy Control UI POST routes remain plan-only
generated compatibility payloads retain their decoded SHA-256 identities

conditional.policy: Built and budgeted for selective compatibility intake, but not active-linked into the governed release until a real caller and explicit boundary review exist.
invariants: conditional roots do not grant provider, tool-runner, MCP, or remote-exec authority
activation requires a real caller, focused tests, and an updated product-boundary receipt

generated.policy: Readable templates and parameter rows are canonical; compressed bundles are deterministic generated artifacts only.
invariants: source.schema.json plus templates.jsonl plus parameters.jsonl are canonical
verify repacks each gzip artifact byte-identically
decoded aggregate source SHA-256 remains compatibility-bound

archive.policy: Never merge archived history back into main; preserve it in a verified bundle before pruning refs.
restore_contract: record every archived ref and object ID
fetch the bundle into an empty bare repository
compare every restored ref and object ID before deleting source refs
